faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's consultation for regenerative medicine?
faqs.answer: Yes. All PRP, PRP, and intimacy treatments require a medical consultation. You will talk with our licensed medical doctor who evaluates your joint, hair, or intimacy health before creating your custom plan.

faqs.question: What does the doctor-guided regenerative program include?
faqs.answer: Your program includes a full medical consultation with a board-certified doctor, your customized in-office PRP or PRP treatment, topical numbing for comfort, and follow-up progress check-ins.

faqs.question: Are PRP injections painful?
faqs.answer: Discomfort varies. We use topical numbing before procedures, and your provider will explain what to expect. Many patients return to normal activities the same day, but recovery varies.

faqs.question: How many sessions do I need to see results?
faqs.answer: Results and the number of sessions vary by person and by treatment area. Your provider will recommend a schedule after your evaluation. Results vary and are not guaranteed.

faqs.question: How does PRP differ from stem cell treatments?
faqs.answer: PRP (platelet-rich plasma) is prepared from your own blood and is not a stem-cell or exosome product. Stem-cell, MSC, and exosome therapies are not currently offered as routine services at OVI.

faqs.question: How do I get started with regenerative medicine?
faqs.answer: Getting started is simple! Call our clinic today at (727) 476-8966 or click 'Book Your Doctor Consultation' online. Our doctor will review your goals and start your personalized recovery plan.
